e2e_command: npm run build && npx --yes http-server dist -p 4177 -a 127.0.0.1 --cors -c-1
start_command: npm run build && npm run preview
notes: start_command used to be an absolute path to build-and-run.bat on a Windows machine, which no other machine can run. The .bat still exists and does npm install, npm run build, npm run preview.
`npm run build` is the only typecheck: it runs `tsc -b` then `vite build`, and there is no separate typecheck script. CI runs npx tsc -b, npx eslint ., npx vitest run, npx vite build in that order.

The DOM test environment is opted into per file with a `// @vitest-environment jsdom` first line, deliberately rather than globally, so the ~90 pure test files keep the fast node environment. Vitest globals are off, so a DOM test file must call cleanup() in its own afterEach.
Local-first: the user's data lives only in their browser. Dexie migrations and the campaign export are the two places where a mistake is unrecoverable.
The bundle <-> Dexie schema parity test walks db.tables at runtime, so a new version(n).stores({...}) fails CI until someone decides whether the table belongs in a backup.
Non-test source has zero as-any / ts-ignore / ts-expect-error. Keep it that way.
Ships to two branches: main and Production.
